ex.s: Comparing Ourselves with Others Can Become a Healthy Habit
ex.t: 把自己和他人比较可能成为一种健康的习惯。

ex.s: Comparing Ourselves with Others Can Strengthen Family Ties
ex.t: 将我们自己与他人相比较可以加强家庭联系

ex.s: We begin to see the interconnectedness of one thing to another in all aspects of our life, of ourselves and the universe.
ex.t: 我们开始看到，在我们生活、我们自己和宇宙的各个方面，一个事物与另一个事物相互关联。

ex.s: We all want it to accept and love ourselves.
ex.t: 我们都希望它接纳并爱我们自己。

ex.s: Rereading makes it possible for us to see the world around us, ourselves included, in a new light.
ex.t: 重读使我们能够以一种新的眼光看待我们周围的世界，包括我们自己。

ex.s: How we feel about ourselves rests not just on whom we compare ourselves with but also on how we think about that comparison.
ex.t: 我们如何看自己，不仅取决于我们和谁比较，也取决于我们如何看待那种比较。

ex.s: Much in the same manner, we may over the years recite to ourselves poems learnt by heart long ago, which have become part of our self-recognition.
ex.t: 同样地，我们多年来可能会背诵那些很久以前就烂熟于心的诗歌，它们已经成为我们自我认知的一部分。

ex.s: It is encouraging to discover that by readily accepting our errors and wisely placing ourselves in the way of being wrong, we can in fact overcome weaknesses and rise stronger.
ex.t: 令人鼓舞的是，我们发现，通过欣然接受错误、明智地让自己处于可能犯错的位置，我们事实上能克服弱点、变得更强。

ex.s: The problem may be that, in our offices, we can't stop ourselves from getting drawn into others’ conversations while we’re trying to focus.
ex.t: 问题可能在于，在我们的办公室里，当我们试图专注时，我们无法阻止自己被卷入别人的对话。

ex.s: We will probably have to force ourselves to waken our curiosity and discontent and keep them awake.
ex.t: 我们可能不得不强迫自己唤醒我们的好奇心和不满，并让它们保持清醒。

ex.s: Everybody can buy takeaway food, but sometimes we’re not aware how cheaply we can make this food ourselves.”
ex.t: 每个人都可以买外卖食物，但有时我们没有意识到自己做饭有多便宜。"

ex.s: So, do we dance in order to make ourselves feel better, calmer, healthier?
ex.t: 那么，我们跳舞是为了让自己感觉更好、更平静、更健康吗？

ex.s: We laughed together, often, but from the stories we’ve shared about ourselves, I know I’m not the only one who faces life’s challenges.
ex.t: 我们一起笑，常常笑，但从我们分享的关于自己的故事里，我知道面对生活挑战的不止我一个。

ex.s: The teacher told us to record ourselves speaking about a holiday.
ex.t: 老师让我们录下自己讲述一次假期的内容。

ex.s: More and more people feel that by using natural dyes, we can remind ourselves of nature's beauty and protect the natural world.
ex.t: 越来越多的人感到，通过使用天然染料，我们可以提醒自己大自然的美，并保护自然世界。

ex.s: Perhaps we comfort ourselves with the knowledge that most of the lies we tell are “white lies”: little lies that we tell to protect others from the truth.
ex.t: 也许我们用这样的认识来安慰自己：我们所说的大部分谎言都是善意的谎言——我们为了保护别人免受真相的伤害而说的小谎。

ex.s: Perhaps we are in fact lying to protect ourselves from the disappointment and anger for others.
ex.t: 也许我们实际上是在撒谎，以保护自己免受对他人的失望和愤怒。

ex.s: Considering the stories we tell about ourselves can help us to change our minds for better.
ex.t: 思考我们讲述的关于自己的故事，有助于我们改善自己的想法。

ex.s: And how do we train ourselves to help them live with, need, and use less?
ex.t: 而我们又该如何训练自己，帮助他们以更少的东西生活、需求和使用呢？

defs.def: （用于强调或代替 we 或 us）我们自己，亲自

ex.s: Our life story is something that starts coming together in our teenage years, when we begin to organise our lives into chapters around key events or life changes, and begin to see ourselves as both the central character and, to a varying extent, the story’s author.
ex.t: 我们的人生故事在青少年时期开始成形，那时我们开始把生活围绕关键事件或人生变化整理成一个个章节，并开始把自己视为故事的中心人物，并且在不同程度上也视为这个故事的创作者。

defs.def: alone; without anyone else （我们）独自，单独

ex.s: “I thought, in this family, we don’t compare ourselves with other people, Dad?” the teenager replied.
ex.t: "我以为，在这个家里，我们不和别人攀比呢，爸爸？"那个少年回答道。

ex.s: The good news is that when that happens, we pick ourselves up, brush ourselves off, and get back to work.
ex.t: 好消息是，当失败发生时，我们会重新站起来，拍掉身上的灰尘，继续工作。

ex.s: Understanding history is vital to understanding ourselves as a people and as a nation． History is much more than the study of dusty old objects and events long past． It is an essential part of who we are today and who we will become． Thornton Middle School History Fair Competition makes understanding history exciting， engaging， and fun!
ex.t: 理解历史对理解我们作为一个民族、一个国家的自我至关重要。历史远不止是对尘封旧物与久远事件的研究。它是我们今天之所是、未来之将是的本质部分。桑顿中学历史博览会竞赛让理解历史变得激动人心、引人入胜且充满乐趣！

ex.s: Understanding these reasons will control our own anger if we are willing to evaluate ourselves with a critical eye.
ex.t: 这是一个了不起的成就，如果没有来自个人、公司和其他社会组织的大力支持，我们是无法实现的。

ex.s: Then we had all introduced ourselves, Mr Meng said, “Well done, everyone!
ex.t: 然后我们都做了自我介绍，孟先生说： “大家做得好！

ex.s: We put ourselves in the passengers’ shoes and help them as much as we can.
ex.t: 我们设身处地为乘客着想，尽我们所能帮助他们。
